The session assumes git is installed and your machine can talk to GitHub. That
is all this page is for. It takes about 8 minutes, and doing it beforehand means
the session can start on the material rather than on installers.

{{< include ../_setup-steps.qmd >}}

## When you are done

- **[The chapter](https://govtmethods.github.io/methodsbrownbag/chapters/11-reproducible-research.html)** — the written
  version, with everything the session covers and more.
- **[The slides](https://govtmethods.github.io/methodsbrownbag/slides/11-reproducible-research.html)** — the projected deck.

Bring a favourite picture of yourself, too. You will want it for the website you
build at the end.
